name: Pechenegs Destroyed at Battle of Levounion
summary: The Byzantine Emperor Alexios I Komnenos allied with the Cumans to destroy the Pecheneg army at the Battle of Levounion in 1091 CE. Contemporary accounts describe the Pecheneg people being effectively annihilated as a military force in a single day. The Cumans replaced the Pechenegs as the dominant steppe power north of the Black Sea.
